categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: Building Materials (notably ready-mixed concrete or remicon), Construction (including apartment and civil engineering projects), Plant (manufacturing and sales of industrial blowers and environmental equipment), and Textiles (manufacturing and sales of acrylic yarn and nonwoven fabrics). Additionally, it has minor operations in retail and other sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes batch plant mixing technology for ready-mixed concrete production, with a network of regional plants to ensure timely delivery. In the plant segment, it leverages advanced blower manufacturing technologies, including partnerships with international firms for high-efficiency fans. Textile production involves acrylic fiber and spunbond nonwoven fabric manufacturing, with ongoing R&D for high-value-added products and efficiency improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large construction companies (e.g., GS Construction, Daewoo, POSCO, Hyundai), public sector entities for infrastructure projects, and industrial clients in power generation, steel, chemical, and environmental sectors for plant products. Textile customers span domestic and international markets, including exports to Africa, Mexico, and the Middle East, with domestic sales through distributors and direct channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with a nationwide network of concrete plants and construction projects. It has overseas operations including a textile manufacturing facility in Indonesia and previously had a joint venture in China. The plant business serves domestic and international markets, exporting industrial blowers globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the supply chain: producing building materials and industrial equipment, and providing construction services directly to end users. It sources raw materials like cement, sand, and aggregates upstream but focuses on manufacturing, assembly, and direct sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the building materials network, enhancing profitability through operational efficiency, and developing high-efficiency industrial fans via industry-academia collaboration. The textile segment focuses on product diversification, high-value-added item development, and production efficiency. The plant segment aims to grow in environmental and renewable energy markets with advanced technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of ready-mixed concrete, construction contracts, industrial blower sales, and textile products. The company also earns income from retail operations and leasing. Sales are mostly direct to construction firms, industrial clients, and distributors, with export sales in textiles and plant equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in the Korean ready-mixed concrete market with a 2.7% market share, leveraging 69 years of experience and a nationwide supply network. In the industrial blower market, it maintains a leading domestic position with about 20% market share and recognized export capabilities. Textile operations face strong competition from low-cost producers in China and Southeast Asia but maintain brand recognition and export presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 866 billion KRW, a 12.8% increase from the previous year, with operating profit of 26.5 billion KRW and net profit of 18.1 billion KRW. Total assets stood at about 1.1 trillion KRW with a debt ratio of 39.5%. The building materials segment is the largest contributor, followed by construction, textiles, and plant segments. The company has shown recovery and growth post-legal restructuring and continues to invest in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its long-established expertise and extensive nationwide network in ready-mixed concrete supply, enabling reliable and timely delivery. It offers one-stop building materials solutions covering basic to finishing materials. In the plant segment, it differentiates through advanced technology, high-efficiency products, and strategic partnerships with global firms. The textile segment focuses on product diversification, high-value-added functional materials, and leveraging export experience to maintain competitiveness.
